row.title: seedlife closed Q-SEED items with no evidence line and turned main red
row.body: When what-works reached autonomous, seedlife --run closed Q-SEED-what-works without an Evidence line, and the queue check reads that as a silent drop. Every PR went red on it. The close now writes the evidence line and a test holds it.

title: seedlife closed Q-SEED items with no evidence line and turned main red
